candidates.name: Existing PR37 / PR39 / PR41 licensed fixture set
candidates.limitation: 12 licensed original photographs have no approved full outlines. Partial assistant-selected core/background witness rectangles are not independent truth. No published dataset match established.

candidates.name: Fashionpedia
candidates.finding: Publisher licenses annotations under CC BY 4.0; image copyrights and host terms are separate. Published segmentation annotations are a potential external source, not evidence of local independent approval.
requiredBeforeImport: exact image and annotation pair with checksums
per-image source, creator, license and redistribution permission evidence
independent inspection of full visible garment and feature coverage
recorded reviewer sign-off and ambiguity policy

candidates.name: ModaNet
candidates.finding: Publisher releases annotation data under CC BY-NC 4.0. This is not sufficient permission for inclusion in this commercial project's reusable test corpus. Image rights are also separate.

candidates.name: DeepFashion2
candidates.finding: Official download requires a request form. Maintainer's commercial-use answer states commercial license is not available. Mirrors and permissive model-code licenses do not establish dataset image or annotation rights.

conclusion: No legally cleared independently verified full-garment masks obtained in this assignment. Fashionpedia remains a conditional route requiring per-image verification; alternatively independently annotate and review already licensed originals without inventing reviewers. No automatic approvals.
